comment.text: Looks like Hetzner is getting into the Inference game, starting with 4 open models. They also seem to offer a managed OpenClaw box.
Makes a lot of sense. They are in a prime position to grab a lot of market share in the eu when the eu starts restricting  non-eu providers.

Jup. I wonder if they will be able to provision enough capacity to keep up with demand. Choices in the EU inference space [1] are still quite limited overall, so any added capacity helps.

[1] https://eualternative.eu/categories/ai-api/

> They also seem to offer a managed OpenClaw box.

Well it appears that only the hosting providers are making money out of OpenClaw and want you to waste money on tokens and hosting.
